description: A stage extension retains earlier feature declarations and appends its own declarations.

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.classes = A
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A
%extend-stage second
%features g
%conditions $.value = "a"
```
